body:
taskId: AISDLC-833
sourceWorktree: /Users/dominique/Documents/dev/ai-sdlc/ai-sdlc/.worktrees/aisdlc-833

Re-ran pnpm build (ok) then pnpm test in .worktrees/aisdlc-833 at f0a51705 with no other build process running. Same 3 failures: sign-attestation.test.mjs tests 14,15 (runtime absent everywhere) and verify-attestation.test.mjs test 7 (too-old runtime). They fail in ~300ms with assertion errors, not timeouts. Running the same two test files on the main checkout fails 5 tests (the 3 plus verify tests 6 and 8), so the cause is not the 833 diff, which touches neither script. The tests find /Users/dominique/Documents/dev/ai-sdlc/ai-sdlc/node_modules/@ai-sdlc/orchestrator/dist/runtime/attestations.js and so the runtime is never absent. Not load: nothing else was building. Code is unchanged; no developer, review, sign or push has been run.
